en: Colorized vintage postcard showing ancient stone ruins with several arched openings and partial columns in the foreground. People are standing and sitting among the ruins. The structure is a classical fountain complex built into a rock face. Printed captions in Greek, French, and English at the bottom identify the site as the Peirene Fountain in Corinth. A watermark with a website address appears across the lower right.
